# deception

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeDeception`](gmeow-eventTypeDeception.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeDeception>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md), [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An event in which one or more participants intentionally or knowingly project a standpoint that diverges from the standpoint they actually hold, causing another party to form a false belief. The kind of a deception event is a value, not a class (events.ttl doctrine).
